cohort: The study cohort consisted of 233 twin and triplet pregnancies (222 twins, 11 triplets) whose medical records were reviewed from the Women's Health Hospital, National Guard Hospital, Riyadh.
finding: Multiple gestations carry significant maternal and neonatal risks, with triplet pregnancies conceived via ART showing increased vulnerability to preterm birth, lower gestational age, and malpresentation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was the predominant mode of birth, accounting for 88.8% of deliveries in the study.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical records covering the period from January 2022 to December 2023.
gest_age: The mean gestational age was 37.1 weeks for twins and 33.5 weeks for triplets, with 92.7% of births occurring at late preterm gestation (>32 weeks).
